title: AZ-900 · Describe cloud service types · Describe Software as a Service

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Software as a Service
questions.question: Which statement best describes Software as a Service (SaaS)?

options.text: Moving workloads to cloud infrastructure with minimal redesign
A managed environment that lets developers build applications without maintaining the full development infrastructure
A model in which customers use a complete cloud-hosted application
Maintaining physical hardware, physical security, and internet connectivity

questions.explanation: Software as a Service (SaaS) is a model in which customers use a complete cloud-hosted application.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Software as a Service
questions.question: In the context of this Microsoft Learn unit, what does SaaS provider responsibility refer to?

options.text: Maintaining physical hardware, physical security, and internet connectivity
Managing most of the infrastructure, platform, application maintenance, and updates
The cloud provider patches and maintains the underlying operating system
Installing, configuring, patching, and maintaining the guest operating system

questions.explanation: SaaS provider responsibility is managing most of the infrastructure, platform, application maintenance, and updates.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Software as a Service
questions.question: Which description correctly matches SaaS customer responsibility?

options.text: A cloud model in which the provider manages infrastructure and platform components while the customer focuses on applications and data
Primarily managing data, identity, access settings, and device access posture
Application code, data, and access controls rather than physical infrastructure
Using complete productivity software delivered as a cloud service

questions.explanation: SaaS customer responsibility is primarily managing data, identity, access settings, and device access posture.

questions.category: Describe Cloud Concepts > Describe cloud service types
questions.description: Microsoft Learn unit: Describe Software as a Service
questions.question: Which of the following is the best definition of SaaS operational overhead?

options.text: The lowest customer operational overhead among IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
Using complete productivity software delivered as a cloud service
Rapidly creating and removing environments while retaining detailed configuration control
Configuring much of the workload networking and security settings above the physical layer

questions.explanation: SaaS operational overhead is the lowest customer operational overhead among IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.

questions.question: What is the primary meaning of SaaS flexibility in Azure fundamentals?

questions.question: Select the TWO statements that are correct according to this unit.

options.text: SaaS provider responsibility: managing most of the infrastructure, platform, application maintenance, and updates.
Software as a Service (SaaS): a model in which customers use a complete cloud-hosted application.
